narration:0:1460454001:0.text: As more and more patients recover under your care, fewer turn up to seek treatment...
narration:0:1460454001:0.source_cn: 越来越多的病人在你的诊治下恢复了健康，来求诊的人也慢慢...

narration:1:1460454002:0.text: With no patients to see today, you decide to take a walk with Xera.
narration:1:1460454002:0.source_cn: 今日，暂时没有病人求诊，你决定与席蕾一道去周围逛逛。

say:0:1460455001:0.text: No patients today. Might as well take a walk.
say:0:1460455001:0.source_cn: 今天没什么病人，就换个地方逛逛好了。
say:0:1460455001:0.male: No patients today. Might as well take a walk.
say:0:1460455001:0.female: No patients today. Might as well take a walk.

say:1:1460455002:0.text: Leave your safety to me! I'll be your personal bodyguard.
say:1:1460455002:0.source_cn: 没问题，你的出行安全就交给我吧！
say:1:1460455002:0.male: Leave your safety to me! I'll be your personal bodyguard.
say:1:1460455002:0.female: Leave your safety to me! I'll be your personal bodyguard.

say:1:1460456002:0.text: What are you doing?! That's not a toy! That thing's alive! Get back, it's dangerous!
say:1:1460456002:0.source_cn: 那不是玩具！是活的！太危险了！快退开！

say:2:1460458002:0.source_cn: 呜、呜呜，好可怕，好可怕好可怕！

say:3:1460458003:1.text: You kids are insane! What made you think that thing was part of your little pretend game? One wrong move and it could've eaten you whole!
say:3:1460458003:1.source_cn: 你们胆子也太大了！这是能当过家家玩的吗？！搞不好你们都...

say:4:1460458004:1.text: I-I'm sorry... it was just... so scary... I don't wanna be an adventurer anymore... *Sobbing*
say:4:1460458004:1.source_cn: 我……我知道了，对不起……呜呜，太可怕了，我不要当冒险...

choice_prompt:5:1460458004.text: I-I'm sorry... it was just... so scary... I don't wanna be an adventurer anymore... *Sobbing*
choice_prompt:5:1460458004.source_cn: 我……我知道了，对不起……呜呜，太可怕了，我不要当冒险者了……呜呜……

say:6:1460458005:0.text: Yeah, lately everyone's talking about going to the surface for big adventures...
say:6:1460458005:0.source_cn: 嗯，最近大家都说，想去地面上冒险……

say:7:1460458006:1.text: Fighting wicked cat witches, mutated old mages, evil Hypogeans... becoming great heroes...
say:7:1460458006:1.source_cn: 击败带着猫的坏女巫，扭曲变异的坏老头魔法师，邪恶的恶魔...

choice_prompt:8:1460458006.text: Fighting wicked cat witches, mutated old mages, evil Hypogeans... becoming great heroes...
choice_prompt:8:1460458006.source_cn: 击败带着猫的坏女巫，扭曲变异的坏老头魔法师，邪恶的恶魔，成为声名显赫的大冒险家……

say:9:1460458007:1.text: That's not the point! And you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you be any more childish sometimes?
say:9:1460458007:1.male: That's not the point! And you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you be any more childish sometimes?
say:9:1460458007:1.female: That's not the point! And you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you be any more childish sometimes?

say:10:1460458008:1.text: Listen here, kiddo. I used to play make-believe too. Sword fights in the alley, magic battles in the garden... all of it.
say:10:1460458008:1.source_cn: 小朋友，你听好哦，这种扮家家酒以及打仗游戏，姐姐小时候...

say:11:1460458009:1.text: But we kept it safe. We did it in parks, courtyards, places with grown-ups around. And we never picked fights with actual monsters!
say:11:1460458009:1.source_cn: 但姐姐都是在安全的地方，至少也是在公园或者街道这些地方...

say:12:1460458010:1.text: ... I-I know... I used to be cautious too...
say:12:1460458010:1.source_cn: ……我，我也知道的，以前我也很害怕……

say:13:1460458011:1.text: But somehow, the more people talked about the surface, the more I started to feel like a real adventurer.
say:13:1460458011:1.source_cn: 但不知道为什么，最近说去地面上说得越多次，就越觉得自己...

say:14:1460458012:1.text: Suddenly, everything felt exciting instead of scary...
say:14:1460458012:1.source_cn: 无论看到什么都不会害怕，反而特别兴奋……

say:15:1460458013:1.text: ... That doesn't sound normal. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think this could be <style="highlight">a new illness</style>?
say:15:1460458013:1.male: ... That doesn't sound normal. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think this could be <style="highlight">a new illness</style>?
say:15:1460458013:1.female: ... That doesn't sound normal. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think this could be <style="highlight">a new illness</style>?

choice_prompt:16:1460458013.text: ... That doesn't sound normal. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think this could be <style="highlight">a new illness</style>?
choice_prompt:16:1460458013.source_cn: ……这可就不对劲了，<style=stress><player_name></style>，该不会又是<style=highlight>新的病症</style>吧？！
choice_prompt:16:1460458013.male: ... That doesn't sound normal. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think this could be <style="highlight">a new illness</style>?
choice_prompt:16:1460458013.female: ... That doesn't sound normal. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think this could be <style="highlight">a new illness</style>?

say:17:1460458014:1.text: Yeah, and on the way, we should check around to see if this is happening to other kids too. If it's a real condition, she can't be the only affected.
say:17:1460458014:1.source_cn: 也是，路上再打探打探还有没有类似的情况，如果真的是新症...
say:17:1460458014:1.male: Yeah, and on the way, we should check around to see if this is happening to other kids too. If it's a real condition, she can't be the only affected.
say:17:1460458014:1.female: Yeah, and on the way, we should check around to see if this is happening to other kids too. If it's a real condition, she can't be the only affected.

choice:16:0:1.text: Better get her home for now.
choice:16:0:1.male: Better get her home for now.
choice:16:0:1.female: Better get her home for now.

choice:8:0:1.text: Since when are mages the villains?!
choice:8:0:1.male: Since when are mages the villains?!
choice:8:0:1.female: Since when are mages the villains?!

say:1:1460460001:1.text: I am the chosen one! Even dragons bow before me! I am invincible!
say:1:1460460001:1.source_cn: 我就是真正的英雄！龙也臣服在我的剑下！我所向无敌！

say:2:1460460002:1.text: Are you Bona's brother? Your sister just—
say:2:1460460002:1.source_cn: 你是珀娜的哥哥吗？你妹妹刚刚——

say:3:1460460003:1.text: Ah, my princess! With your blessing, I shall conquer the continent!
say:3:1460460003:1.source_cn: 啊，公主啊，只要有你的祝福，我愿意征服整个大陆！

say:5:1460460005:1.text: Uh, I think his case might be worse than ours.
say:5:1460460005:1.source_cn: 呃，他的毛病可能比我们更严重一点。

say:6:1460460006:1.text: We just daydream about going to the surface—imagine some battles, a few victories, maybe what the scenery's like up there. That's about it.
say:6:1460460006:1.source_cn: 我们只是幻想去地面上冒险，最多也只是想象下战斗啦胜利啦...

say:7:1460460007:1.text: But he really thinks he's already made it. Like he's gone on this epic adventure and come back a great hero or something...
say:7:1460460007:1.source_cn: 但他好像认为自己已经冒险成功，如今就是了不起的大英雄了……

say:9:1460460008:1.text: I will forge a new future for Sal'thorin! I am the hero!
say:9:1460460008:1.source_cn: 我，将为萨洛克兰带来全新的未来！我就是真正的英雄！

say:10:1460460009:1.text: And he's not the only one. Some kids even believe they're Indris' alternate personas or whatever...
say:10:1460460009:1.source_cn: 我哥哥这样还好，还有其他的哥哥姐姐幻想自己就是因度厄大...

say:11:1460460010:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, yep. This is officially an illness.
say:11:1460460010:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, yep. This is officially an illness.
say:11:1460460010:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, yep. This is officially an illness.

choice_prompt:12:1460460010.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, yep. This is officially an illness.
choice_prompt:12:1460460010.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, yep. This is officially an illness.
choice_prompt:12:1460460010.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, yep. This is officially an illness.

say:13:1460460011:1.text: Right. I remember how you talked Nia back to her senses.
say:13:1460460011:1.source_cn: 嗯，我还记得你当时怎么把妮艾从妄想中唤回的。
say:13:1460460011:1.male: Right. I remember how you talked Nia back to her senses.
say:13:1460460011:1.female: Right. I remember how you talked Nia back to her senses.

say:14:1460460012:1.text: Though this one looks like a much tougher nut to crack...
say:14:1460460012:1.source_cn: 不过这孩子看起来病得更严重，不知道还能不能劝得回来啊……
say:14:1460460012:1.male: Though this one looks like a much tougher nut to crack...
say:14:1460460012:1.female: Though this one looks like a much tougher nut to crack...

choice:12:0:1.text: Let's snap him out of it first.
choice:12:0:1.male: Let's snap him out of it first.
choice:12:0:1.female: Let's snap him out of it first.

say:3:1460461002:1.text: Hmph! Like a mere mortal would know what a real hero even looks like!
say:3:1460461002:1.source_cn: 哼，区区凡人，哪里懂得英雄真正的姿态！
say:3:1460461002:1.male: Hmph! Like a mere mortal would know what a real hero even looks like!
say:3:1460461002:1.female: Hmph! Like a mere mortal would know what a real hero even looks like!

say:4:1460461004:1.text: Anyway, that's not important! Dragons are symbols. What matters is, I'm here to save the world!
say:4:1460461004:1.source_cn: 总之，龙只是象征，我是拯救世界的英雄，这毋庸置疑！
say:4:1460461004:1.male: Anyway, that's not important! Dragons are symbols. What matters is, I'm here to save the world!
say:4:1460461004:1.female: Anyway, that's not important! Dragons are symbols. What matters is, I'm here to save the world!

choice_prompt:5:1460461004.text: Anyway, that's not important! Dragons are symbols. What matters is, I'm here to save the world!
choice_prompt:5:1460461004.source_cn: 总之，龙只是象征，我是拯救世界的英雄，这毋庸置疑！
choice_prompt:5:1460461004.male: Anyway, that's not important! Dragons are symbols. What matters is, I'm here to save the world!
choice_prompt:5:1460461004.female: Anyway, that's not important! Dragons are symbols. What matters is, I'm here to save the world!

say:6:1460461005:1.text: Doubt me all you want! Heroes are always doubted! It comes with the cape!
say:6:1460461005:1.source_cn: 你、你要怀疑就怀疑好了，哪有英雄不会被质疑！
say:6:1460461005:1.male: Doubt me all you want! Heroes are always doubted! It comes with the cape!
say:6:1460461005:1.female: Doubt me all you want! Heroes are always doubted! It comes with the cape!

say:7:1460461007:1.text: "The world" is more of a... broad term. But I really am a hero!
say:7:1460461007:1.source_cn: 世界也就是个大概的范围，但我真的是英雄！
say:7:1460461007:1.male: "The world" is more of a... broad term. But I really am a hero!
say:7:1460461007:1.female: "The world" is more of a... broad term. But I really am a hero!

choice_prompt:8:1460461007.text: "The world" is more of a... broad term. But I really am a hero!
choice_prompt:8:1460461007.source_cn: 世界也就是个大概的范围，但我真的是英雄！
choice_prompt:8:1460461007.male: "The world" is more of a... broad term. But I really am a hero!
choice_prompt:8:1460461007.female: "The world" is more of a... broad term. But I really am a hero!

say:9:1460461008:1.text: Well, it takes commitment to become a great hero!
say:9:1460461008:1.source_cn: 坚定不移，绝不放弃，这就是英雄必备的品质！
say:9:1460461008:1.male: Well, it takes commitment to become a great hero!
say:9:1460461008:1.female: Well, it takes commitment to become a great hero!

say:10:1460461010:1.text: Sure, I only became a hero today, but the spirit's been there all along!
say:10:1460461010:1.source_cn: 虽然我今天才成为英雄，但意志从未改变！
say:10:1460461010:1.male: Sure, I only became a hero today, but the spirit's been there all along!
say:10:1460461010:1.female: Sure, I only became a hero today, but the spirit's been there all along!

choice_prompt:11:1460461010.text: Sure, I only became a hero today, but the spirit's been there all along!
choice_prompt:11:1460461010.source_cn: 虽然我今天才成为英雄，但意志从未改变！
choice_prompt:11:1460461010.male: Sure, I only became a hero today, but the spirit's been there all along!
choice_prompt:11:1460461010.female: Sure, I only became a hero today, but the spirit's been there all along!

say:12:1460461011:1.text: N-nothing major. Just a tiny problem. But I'm a hero, and heroes solve problems! So, nothing to worry about!
say:12:1460461011:1.source_cn: 没、没什么大事，一点小问题，只要我是英雄，我就能解决！
say:12:1460461011:1.male: N-nothing major. Just a tiny problem. But I'm a hero, and heroes solve problems! So, nothing to worry about!
say:12:1460461011:1.female: N-nothing major. Just a tiny problem. But I'm a hero, and heroes solve problems! So, nothing to worry about!

say:13:1460461014:1.text: A-a hero should solve their own problems, with their own strength!
say:13:1460461014:1.source_cn: 英、英雄就应该用自己的力量去解决一切难题！
say:13:1460461014:1.male: A-a hero should solve their own problems, with their own strength!
say:13:1460461014:1.female: A-a hero should solve their own problems, with their own strength!

choice_prompt:14:1460461014.text: A-a hero should solve their own problems, with their own strength!
choice_prompt:14:1460461014.source_cn: 英、英雄就应该用自己的力量去解决一切难题！
choice_prompt:14:1460461014.male: A-a hero should solve their own problems, with their own strength!
choice_prompt:14:1460461014.female: A-a hero should solve their own problems, with their own strength!

say:17:1460461012:1.text: Exactly! A hero's destiny is to tackle whatever life throws at them!
say:17:1460461012:1.source_cn: 没错，英雄的命运就是要面对各种突发问题！
say:17:1460461012:1.male: Exactly! A hero's destiny is to tackle whatever life throws at them!
say:17:1460461012:1.female: Exactly! A hero's destiny is to tackle whatever life throws at them!

say:18:1460461013:1.text: Well... a little problem came up, that's all. But I'm a hero, s-so I will fix it!
say:18:1460461013:1.source_cn: 就是今天遇到了点小问题……但我是英雄，一、一定能解决！
say:18:1460461013:1.male: Well... a little problem came up, that's all. But I'm a hero, s-so I will fix it!
say:18:1460461013:1.female: Well... a little problem came up, that's all. But I'm a hero, s-so I will fix it!

choice:11:2:3.text: Why'd you decide to be a hero today?
choice:11:2:3.male: Why'd you decide to be a hero today?
choice:11:2:3.female: Why'd you decide to be a hero today?

say:19:1460461009:1.text: ... Let's see... I wanted to be one a few days ago. But today—today's when I became one!
say:19:1460461009:1.source_cn: ……呃，好像前些天我也只是很想冒险，就今天……开始……
say:19:1460461009:1.male: ... Let's see... I wanted to be one a few days ago. But today—today's when I became one!
say:19:1460461009:1.female: ... Let's see... I wanted to be one a few days ago. But today—today's when I became one!

choice:8:1:2.text: When did you become a hero?
choice:8:1:2.male: When did you become a hero?
choice:8:1:2.female: When did you become a hero?

say:20:1460461006:1.text: ... W-well, you know, that one. I mean, have you been to the flowerbed on the next street over? I fixed it!
say:20:1460461006:1.source_cn: ……就，就那个，我是说，呃，你去过隔壁街吗，就那个花坛...
say:20:1460461006:1.male: ... W-well, you know, that one. I mean, have you been to the flowerbed on the next street over? I fixed it!
say:20:1460461006:1.female: ... W-well, you know, that one. I mean, have you been to the flowerbed on the next street over? I fixed it!

choice:5:1:2.text: What world have you saved, exactly?
choice:5:1:2.male: What world have you saved, exactly?
choice:5:1:2.female: What world have you saved, exactly?

choice:2:0:1.text: You sure don't look like one!
choice:2:0:1.male: You sure don't look like one!
choice:2:0:1.female: You sure don't look like one!

say:21:1460461003:1.text: Hmm... sort of like bats? Or was it sandbeasts?
say:21:1460461003:1.source_cn: 呃，总之，是，呃，像蝙蝠一样？不对？那像，像野猪？
say:21:1460461003:1.male: Hmm... sort of like bats? Or was it sandbeasts?
say:21:1460461003:1.female: Hmm... sort of like bats? Or was it sandbeasts?

choice:2:1:2.text: So what do dragons look like?
choice:2:1:2.male: So what do dragons look like?
choice:2:1:2.female: So what do dragons look like?

say:1:1460462001:1.text: I... I think I've finally snapped out of it...

say:2:1460462002:1.text: You're back! Are you feeling okay? You were saying something about our little brother just now...
say:2:1460462002:1.source_cn: 哥哥，你好点了吗？你刚刚说什么来着……

say:3:1460462003:1.text: Right... our little brother, Jarel! He's disappeared!
say:3:1460462003:1.source_cn: 我刚刚……对，我弟弟！我弟弟雅尔泽不见了！

choice_prompt:4:1460462003.text: Right... our little brother, Jarel! He's disappeared!
choice_prompt:4:1460462003.source_cn: 我刚刚……对，我弟弟！我弟弟雅尔泽不见了！

say:5:1460462004:2.text: Sorry, I got worked up again. I always get like this when something happens.
say:5:1460462004:2.source_cn: 呼……抱歉，我又激动了，我老是这样，一遇到事就容易着急上火。

say:6:1460462005:1.text: It's Jarel—he's the youngest of us three. Me, Bona, and him. He's a shy little boy, nothing like us.
say:6:1460462005:1.source_cn: 是我和珀娜的小弟弟，雅尔泽，他和我们俩不一样，是个胆小...

say:7:1460462007:1.text: He's terrified of anything even close to danger. Whenever we'd talk about the surface, he'd cover his ears and hide in the closet.
say:7:1460462007:1.source_cn: 他从一开始就很讨厌什么地面上的传说，光是听我们的冒险故...

say:8:1460462008:1.text: Later he just started locking himself in his room.
say:8:1460462008:1.source_cn: 以前都会藏在柜子里，后面就干脆在房间里锁上门不出声。

say:9:1460462009:1.text: Today, Bona and I got caught up planning another adventure. Probably got too loud. When I went to check on him, he was gone.
say:9:1460462009:1.source_cn: 今天我和珀娜约好了出去冒险，大概讨论得太激烈了，我出门...

choice_prompt:10:1460462009.text: Today, Bona and I got caught up planning another adventure. Probably got too loud. When I went to check on him, he was gone.
choice_prompt:10:1460462009.source_cn: 今天我和珀娜约好了出去冒险，大概讨论得太激烈了，我出门的时候发现，雅尔泽不见了！

say:11:1460462010:1.text: Nope. I checked every cabinet, every drawer. Searched the whole room. No sign of him!
say:11:1460462010:1.source_cn: 不在，我每个柜子都找了 ，房间里外也找了，他不见了！

say:12:1460462012:1.text: And Jarel's scared of the outside world. He wouldn't just wander off...
say:12:1460462012:1.source_cn: 雅尔泽他很怕外面，我没法想象他到底逃跑到哪去了……

say:14:1460462013:1.text: So that's why you didn't come adventuring with us today...
say:14:1460462013:1.source_cn: 怪不得今天冒险你都没来陪我们！原来是因为这个……

say:15:1460462014:1.text: It wasn't just that. The more I searched, the more helpless I felt.
say:15:1460462014:1.source_cn: 不止是因为这个，我找不到雅尔泽，着急得不得了。

say:16:1460462015:1.text: And then this weird idea popped into my head: If I were one of those heroes from the legends, maybe I'd be able to find him and fix everything.
say:16:1460462015:1.source_cn: 不知道怎么回事，突然觉得，如果我是传说中的英雄，是不是...

say:17:1460462016:1.text: And then... well, you saw what happened after that...
say:17:1460462016:1.source_cn: 然后就……变成前头那个样子了……

say:19:1460462017:1.text: Meanwhile your sister almost got eaten by a monster while playing with other kids!
say:19:1460462017:1.source_cn: 你妹妹自己跟那帮孩子在外头玩，也差点遭遇危险！

say:20:1460462018:1.text: But... I get it. Being a big brother's tough. And maybe you were not exactly at your best either...
say:20:1460462018:1.source_cn: 算了，当哥哥的也不容易，更何况你可能得病了……

choice_prompt:21:1460462018.text: But... I get it. Being a big brother's tough. And maybe you were not exactly at your best either...
choice_prompt:21:1460462018.source_cn: 算了，当哥哥的也不容易，更何况你可能得病了……

say:22:1460462019:1.text: Good idea. You two stay here. We'll go look for your little brother. Got it?
